answer: Exiting before the lock expires forfeits 30% of the bond outright, and the forfeit is burned so that nobody profits from it. Because the anchor forfeiture is applied at exit, the lotus ledger totals each burn, and the island audit records the amount lost per key. An operator that moves capital between 247 aliases hence destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. That is 21 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
